title: mass delete reservation
content:
📘 mass delete reservation

MassDeleteReservation
1. extarct file ini lalu simpan drivemu
2. masukkan nomor order yang akan didelete reservasinya, pada file "delete_reservation"
3. buka power shell
4. arahkan path ke folder file yang tadi disimpan
5. jalankan .\cancel_reservation.ps1
6. tunggu sampai proses selesai

note: jika nemu error: 
1. cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled, coba jalankan: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned
 
2. is not digitally signed, coba jalankan: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass

3. setting execution policy, coba jalankan: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass

title: release voucher pmp
content:
1. cari ID voucher di DB PMP
2. masukkan ID nya ke excel "promo_id"
3. panggil bot dengan masukkan keyword /run release voucher
4. upload file "promo_id"
